name: Outbreak: Fight to Survive
summary: Outbreak is a zombie apocalypse game where you find yourself in a zombie apocalypse world facing mutants and monsters. Being the main hero of the zombie apocalypse game, your aim is to save the world, fight to survive, stay alive, and find the laboratory from which the virus is spreading to other worlds. You have to solve interesting puzzles in this zombie outbreak and make the right decisions, as every decision you make has consequences.
